concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished identity concept presentation image for Juniverse, the personal site of Jun Bai spanning trustworthy AI research and photography. This is a new original brand identity, not a redesign of a supplied image. Exact brand text, spelled precisely: "Juniverse" (capital J followed by lowercase u n i v e r s e). Restrained, timeless, distinctive, highly legible on a small website header. Flat, vector-friendly shapes and impeccable optical kerning. Strictly monochrome black and white. Warm light gray #F2F2F2 main background, charcoal #222125 dark comparison strip at the bottom. Landscape artboard, roughly 3:2. Consistent generous editorial layout: upper area shows a large standalone J emblem at left and the main Juniverse wordmark to its right with abundant negative space; a much smaller header-sized complete wordmark below demonstrates real-world legibility. Bottom charcoal strip shows the emblem and full wordmark reversed in white. Keep the same identity consistently across all placements. Only textual content is Juniverse; no invented slogan, annotations, font names, numbered labels, UI boilerplate, watermarks or lorem ipsum. No 3D, gradients, shadows, paper textures, mockups on merchandise, colored accents, camera icons, brains, robot imagery or elaborate space illustrations. Only one very small four-point star detail as appropriate. The full wordmark must remain readable without depending on the symbol. DIRECTION A — EDITORIAL SERIF. Design a custom medium-weight, refined contemporary serif wordmark with restrained contrast, subtly flared serifs and open counters, evocative of an independent photography journal and thoughtful scholarship. Letterforms should feel considered and current, never an ornate high-fashion brand. Replace only the dot over the lowercase i with a tiny crisp four-point star, balanced to the cap-height and small-size legibility. The standalone emblem is the same distinctive capital J drawn from the wordmark, a graceful solid hooked serif form with a tiny four-point star in the upper-right negative space. Match stroke weights carefully. Prioritize beautiful typography over decoration.

DIRECTION C — GEOMETRIC MONO. A bespoke refined monospaced / semi-monospaced wordmark inspired by precise typewriter typography and an independent research notebook. Medium strokes, square-cut terminals softened by generous circular curves, single-storey u-shaped forms where appropriate and a striking curved capital J. Clear equal rhythm without looking like a terminal command or code syntax. Give the v a distinctive clean angular apex and carefully drawn e counters.
